title: ASTERISM: Do Multimodal LLMs Actually Look at All the Images?
abstract: arXiv:2611.32316v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multi-image benchmarks aim to test whether a multimodal large language model (MLLM) combines evidence across images, but many of their items can be answered from a single image. Across about 33k items from 19 public benchmarks, our audit and a two-stage single-image filter find that one image or the question alone settles 24.2% of them. On these items, MLLMs recover from one image a median 78% of the accuracy that all images add over the text alone, so these items reward answering from one image, which we call the single-image shortcut. MLLMs take this shortcut even on items where one image is not enough. On such items, most of their wrong answers repeat an answer they give from one image, at a rate well above chance. We build ASTERISM, to our knowledge the largest audited multi-image benchmark, from these 19 benchmarks by keeping their items that need more than one image. translated_title: ASTERISM：多模态大语言模型真的会看所有图像吗？
translated_abstract: 多图像基准旨在测试多模态大语言模型（MLLM）能否跨图像整合证据，但其中许多题目仅凭单张图像即可回答。通过对来自19个公开基准的约3.3万道题目进行审计，并采用两阶段单图过滤器，我们发现其中24.2%的题目仅凭一张图像或仅凭问题本身即可解答。在这些题目上，MLLM仅凭一张图像就能获得全部图像相对纯文本所带来的准确率提升的中位数78%，因此这些题目实际上奖励了“从单张图像作答”的行为，我们称之为单图捷径（single-image shortcut）。即便在单张图像不足以作答的题目上，MLLM也会走这条捷径：在这类题目上，它们的大部分错误答案与其仅凭单张图像时给出的答案重复，且该比例远高于随机水平。我们基于这19个基准构建了ASTERISM——据我们所知是规模最大的经过审计的多图像基准——仅保留其中需要多张图像才能作答的题目。其1.87万道题目（其中2000道经过修正或重写）共享同一（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该研究审计了19个多图像基准，发现约24%的题目存在“单图捷径”问题（仅凭一张图像即可作答），并据此构建了目前规模最大的经审计多图像基准ASTERISM（1.87万道题），专门保留真正需要多张图像才能解答的题目。
en_tdlr: This study audits 19 multi-image benchmarks and reveals a "single-image shortcut" where 24.2% of items can be answered from one image alone, then builds ASTERISM, the largest audited multi-image benchmark (18.7k items), by keeping only items that genuinely require multiple images.
